about: CORDIS (EU research results portal): look up EU-funded research projects and their reports, deliverables, OpenAIRE publications, Results-in-Brief and news articles, browse news and domain-of-application listings, and run keyword searches over the Projects Map data.

commands.summary: Get the full fact sheet of an EU research project (Horizon Europe, H2020, FP7…) as JSON, looked up by grant agreement ID
Get a project's periodic or final report summary: context and objectives, work performed, and results so far
List a project's public deliverables, data management plans and publications, with download links (from the project's Results tab)
Get the publications, datasets, software and other research outputs that OpenAIRE links to a project

params.name: project_id
params.description: Grant agreement / project ID (sent as rcn together with paramType=id)

commands.summary: Get a result/report record as JSON (periodic report summary, work performed, final results, related project), looked up by its RCN

params.name: rcn
params.description: CORDIS record number (RCN) of the result, e.g. 1169591

commands.summary: Get a CORDIS article (news, Results in Brief, Ask an expert…) as JSON, including body, keywords and related projects/articles

params.name: id
params.description: Article id with slug as it appears in article URLs, e.g. 467900-can-birds-understand-the-songs-of-other-species

commands.summary: List the latest CORDIS news articles shown on the news hub, by section (Scientific advances, Ask an expert…)
List recent articles for a domain of application (Energy, Health, Digital Economy, Climate Change and Environment, …)

params.name: domain
params.description: Domain slug, e.g. energy, digital-economy, climate-change-and-environment (the lowercase, hyphenated domain name)

commands.summary: Keyword search over EU-funded projects and participating organisations (Projects Map data): returns hit counts plus organisations with address, coordinates and their projects (budget, dates, scheme);
Get the OpenAPI spec of the CORDIS Data Extraction Tool API (bulk extractions; using the API needs a personal API key)
